{{2025–26 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2025–26 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Northwestern University]] in the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by 13th-year head coach [[Chris Collins (basketball)|Chris Collins]]. The Wildcats played their home games at [[Welsh–Ryan Arena]] in [[Evanston, Illinois]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 17–16, 7–13 in [[2024–25 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a five-way tie for 12th place. As the No. 13 seed in the [[2025 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2024-25 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] in the first round before losing to [[2024-25 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] in the second round. Following the team's loss, they declined any postseason invitations.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dailynorthwestern.com/2025/03/13/lateststories/mens-basketball-northwesterns-season-ends-with-70-63-loss-to-no-18-wisconsin/ |title=Northwestern men's basketball suffers season-ending loss to Wisconsin }}</ref>
